description:
You are a Quality Systems Engineer at a contract manufacturer expanding the quality management system to cover additional product lines in Odoo 17 (http://localhost:8069, login: admin / admin). Complete all of the following:

1. Create a new quality alert team named "Product Line B - Compliance Unit".
2. Create a Quality Control Point titled "Surface Finish Verification" for the product "Customizable Desk" with Operation Type set to Receipts, Control Type set to Measure, and set its Failure Message to: "REJECT: Surface finish Ra exceeds 1.6 micrometer specification per ISO 4287. Quarantine unit and issue NCR to supplier. Do not proceed with assembly until replacement part is received."
3. Create a Quality Control Point titled "Load-Bearing Capacity Test" for the product "Large Cabinet" with Operation Type set to Receipts, Control Type set to Pass - Fail, and set its Failure Message to: "REJECT: Load test failure. Unit must withstand 200 kg static load per EN 14073-2. Isolate failed unit and report to quality team immediately."
4. Find the existing quality alert "Desk Height Adjustment Mechanism Stiff" (currently in In Progress stage) and add the following Preventive Action: "Redesign height adjustment mechanism with upgraded linear actuator rated for 50,000 cycles minimum. Implement incoming torque test on all adjustment mechanisms. Require supplier PPAP submission for redesigned component before production release."
5. Find the existing quality alert "Chair Foam Density Below Grade" (currently in In Progress stage) and add the following Preventive Action: "Qualify secondary foam supplier meeting ISO 3386-1 density requirements of 42 kg/m3 minimum. Implement incoming foam density sampling test at n=5 per delivery batch. Update approved supplier list and material specification MS-FOAM-004."
